# Captured pair consumer

The original private static method binds three independent formals through
Outer<S>, Outer<S>.Member<T,V>, two T inputs and Spec<T>, followed by a closed
label and int. Frozen direct, precompiled, reflection and method-handle callers
observe every identity, captured outer, partial trace, nominal bound, nulls,
int extrema and failure order. Four wrong programs must fail. The existing
inner-to-static source projection and exact changed Signature are disclosed;
all other original entries, metadata and Exceptions remain checked.
